title: Palm Disintegration and Height-Profile Recovery for Projected Hardy--Szegő Zeros
summary: We study the horizontal projection of the upper-half-plane Hardy--Szegő zero process after independent height-dependent thinning, with height retained as an unobserved mark. We identify the reduced Palm law of the projected process by disintegrating over the missing height coordinate, describe the conditional law of the two heights associated with a pair of projected points and its near- and far-separation limits, and obtain the small-spacing asymptotic for the right nearest neighbour.
